info.title: Kirby: Right Back at Ya! (ITA)
info.synopsis: La serie si svolge sul pianeta Popstar a Dreamland nei pressi della città di Zeetown (Cappytown nella versione inglese), e narra le avventure di Kirby che combatte i mostri creati dalla NightMare Enterprises

episodes.title: L'arrivo di Kirby
episodes.synopsis: King Dedede orders an octopus-like monster, waking the young Star Warrior Kirby and bringing him to Dream Land. After being accused of being the monster, Kirby saves the life of young Tiff and gains some trust. Meta Knight also trusts him and brings him out to the final confrontation with the evil octopus.
